close_reason: resolved: handle_chat_get delegates to generic handle_get (JMAP-63k)
description: jmap-server/handlers.rs exports handle_get<O,B> which is a fully generic /get implementation. chat-server/chat.rs handle_chat_get and space.rs handle_space_get are verbatim copies of that same 35-line pattern (ids parse, get_objects, get_state, serialize, build json). Neither calls handle_get. mail-server handlers follow the same copy pattern. If handle_get is updated (e.g. to pass properties to the backend), every copy must be updated separately. Suggested rewrite: have domain-specific /get handlers call handle_get<O, B>(backend, args).await and return that result directly, unless they need domain-specific property filtering beyond what the generic handles.
title: Cross-crate divergence: /get handler not reusing generic handle_get
